title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/IwasawaDecomposition): delegate exists_pieces_match to ExistsMatchingPiecesOfCell
body:
Delegate `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.exists_pieces_match` in `ExistsMarkedFormPiecesRaysOfSimplicialCells.lean` directly to `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.MatchingPieces.exists_pieces_match` in `CompanionTheory/SpectralGeometry/LocalGlobalProofs/ConvexCones/ExistsMatchingPiecesOfCell.lean` at `(𝓞 E, H.bar, H.w0)`, removing the unused duplicated `Host`-specialized helpers.

Removed declarations in `ExistsMarkedFormPiecesRaysOfSimplicialCells.lean`:
- `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.exists_desc_rays_pullAdd`
- `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.inRCone_pullAdd_of_isCell`
